## Hypothesis

We are trying to capture the edge in overnight SPY movements using the SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK trigger with a VIX-trend regime filter. The hypothesis is that this combination will produce a high edge_capture and improve the overall performance of the engine.

## Mechanism

The mechanism involves using the SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK trigger with a VIX-trend regime filter to identify potential overnight trades. The trigger will fire when the SPY price breaks through a defined level, and the VIX-trend filter will ensure that the trade is only taken when the VIX is in an escalating trend.
